headword: {敵前逃亡|てきぜんとうぼう}
gloss: desertion in the face of the enemy; running away at the crucial moment

definitions.gloss: desertion in the face of the enemy
definitions.explanation: Fleeing from a position when the enemy is at hand — historically one of the gravest military offenses.

definitions.gloss: backing out just when one is needed most
definitions.explanation: Used figuratively, and half-jokingly, of someone who abandons a task, a match, or a group right at the decisive moment.

examples.japanese: {敵前逃亡|てきぜんとうぼう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{重|おも}い→重い：00804_omoi⟧⟦{罪|つみ}→罪：03532_tsumi⟧だった。
examples.english: Desertion in the face of the enemy was a grave crime.

examples.japanese: ⟦{兵士|へいし}→兵士：11680_heishi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{敵前逃亡|てきぜんとうぼう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{罪|つみ}→罪：03532_tsumi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{裁|さば}かれた→裁く：02112_sabaku⟧。
examples.english: The soldier was tried for deserting in the face of the enemy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{当時|とうじ}→当時：01615_touji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{軍法|ぐんぽう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{敵前逃亡|てきぜんとうぼう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{死刑|しけい}→死刑：13200_shikei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧こと⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Under the military law of the time, desertion in the face of the enemy could carry the death penalty.

examples.japanese: ⟦ここ→ここ：00961_koko⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦やめたら→やめる：00909_yameru⟧{敵前逃亡|てきぜんとうぼう}だ。
examples.english: Quitting now would be running away at the crucial moment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部長|ぶちょう}→部長：01017_buchou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧⟦{当日|とうじつ}→当日：04558_toujitsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{休|やす}んで→休む：00606_yasumu⟧、{敵前逃亡|てきぜんとうぼう}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われた→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: The manager took the day off on the day of the negotiations, and people said he'd run away from the front line.

examples.japanese: ⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{直前|ちょくぜん}→直前：13651_chokuzen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{辞|じ}める⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{敵前逃亡|てきぜんとうぼう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ようで、⟦どうしても→どうしても：03476_doushitemo⟧⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}まなかった→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: Quitting right before the presentation felt like desertion under fire, and I just couldn't bring myself to do it.

notes:
Compound of {敵前|てきぜん} (before the enemy) and ⟦{逃亡|とうぼう}→逃亡：14367_toubou⟧ (flight, desertion).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {敵前逃亡|てきぜんとうぼう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{罪|つみ}→罪：03532_tsumi⟧: the crime of desertion in the face of the enemy
- {敵前逃亡|てきぜんとうぼう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to desert in the face of the enemy
- ⟦まるで→まるで：03739_marude⟧{敵前逃亡|てきぜんとうぼう}だ: it's practically desertion

USAGE:
Sense 2 is the one learners will actually hear, usually as criticism softened by exaggeration. Because the literal sense is severe, it is too strong for a genuinely minor absence.
